meta.title: For Coaches — The Switzerland Chapter of ICF
meta.description: Membership, credentialing pathways, learning and community for professional coaches practising in Switzerland.

hero.lede: Whether freshly credentialed or a seasoned MCC — a welcoming community for coaches of all backgrounds, languages and methodologies.

benefits.title: Membership benefits.
benefits.lede: One membership, a full year of learning, connection and professional visibility across all Swiss regions.
benefits.ctaNote: Membership is managed through the ICF Global member portal.

items.title: 62+ events per year
items.desc: Networking, learning, ethics and peer coaching throughout the year.

items.title: A community in your region
items.desc: Zurich, Geneva, Lausanne, Basel, Bern, Ticino and Ost-Schweiz.

items.title: Events in four languages
items.desc: Join in English, French, German or Italian — whichever fits you best.

items.title: Professional development
items.desc: Webinars and masterclasses with CCEUs for your credential renewal.

items.title: Peer coaching
items.desc: Structured peer coaching cycles and Coaching Gym formats.

items.title: Member directory listing
items.desc: Visibility in Find a Coach for clients and organisations.

items.title: A voice in governance
items.desc: Town Halls, Board Coffee and open participation in chapter decisions.

items.title: Ethics support
items.desc: Guidance on ethical practice and the ICF credentialing process.

items.title: Access to ICF Global
items.desc: The Converge Summit and the full global resource library.

tabs.label: Professional dev.
tabs.title: Webinars and masterclasses
tabs.desc: Executive leadership, AI in coaching, neurodiversity and inclusion, team coaching and business development — practical sessions led by experienced practitioners.

tabs.label: Ethics
tabs.title: Ethics in practice
tabs.desc: Three in-person and two virtual ethics events in 2026. Reflect, discuss real dilemmas and earn CCEUs. Led by Natacha Andenmatten.

tabs.label: DEIB
tabs.title: Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging
tabs.desc: Quarterly DEIB Open Houses, the Inclusive Coaching Inspiration Kit, neurodiversity webinars and member stories — resources for coaching across diverse contexts.

tabs.label: Peer coaching
tabs.title: Practise with peers
tabs.desc: Structured peer coaching cycles, Coaching Gyms and Open Space formats — multi-language and across all communities.

tabs.label: Credentials
tabs.title: Credentialing support
tabs.desc: ICF credentialing info sessions for ACC, PCC and MCC, step-by-step guides and two credentialing webinars per year.

tabs.label: AI in coaching
tabs.title: AI in coaching working group
tabs.desc: Led by Nicola Simionato. Exploring AI tools, the ethics of AI in practice and member education on responsible use.

credentials.title: A recognised path from ACC to MCC.

items.desc: Associate Certified Coach — the entry pathway for newly trained coaches.
Professional Certified Coach — the standard for established practitioners.
Master Certified Coach — the highest tier, for masterful practitioners.

deib.title: Coaching across difference.
deib.desc: Our DEIB resources help you coach across cultures, languages and identities — with competence and care. Access our Inclusive Coaching Inspiration Kit, attend a DEIB Open House, or join a neurodiversity-focused learning session.
items: Quarterly DEIB Open House events with real cases
Inclusive Coaching Inspiration Kit for all members

chapters.title: Find your regional community.
chapters.desc: From Zürich to Romandie to Ticino, our chapter communities meet regularly to learn, practise and support one another.

volunteer.title: Shape the future of coaching in Switzerland.
volunteer.desc: Lead a community, join a project team, host events or contribute to DEIB, ethics and communications. Leadership roles are open across all regions and languages.

items.quote: The peer coaching cycles pushed my practice further in one year than anything else I have done. And I found colleagues I now call friends.
items.name: Nadia Berger

items.quote: Coming from a corporate HR background, the credentialing sessions gave me a clear path to ACC — and the Geneva community made the journey far less lonely.
items.name: Marc Dubois

items.quote: Being able to attend events in Italian in Ticino, then in English nationally, is exactly the kind of inclusion that keeps me engaged as a member.
items.name: Giulia Ferrari
